project_type: Angular 19 bookstore SPA being migrated to React 19 + Vite + TypeScript
build_system: Currently Angular CLI (ng build/serve/test). Target: Vite for build/dev, Vitest + React Testing Library for tests.
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build and confirm no errors. 2. Run npm test and confirm all tests pass. 3. Run npm run dev to start dev server and confirm it loads.
setup_instructions: Node.js v22 available via nvm. npm install to install deps.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22 and npm available.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing application functionality and UI. All models/interfaces must be preserved. All test coverage must be ported.
key_patterns: Angular app uses: standalone components with inline templates and styles, RxJS BehaviorSubject for state management in services (CartService, OrderService), BookService with hardcoded data returning Observables, Angular Router with 6 routes, ReactiveFormsModule for checkout form validation. React equivalent: React Context + useReducer/useState for state, React Router v7 for routing, CSS modules or plain CSS for styling, functional components with hooks.
directory_structure: src/app/models/ - TypeScript interfaces (Book, CartItem, Order). src/app/services/ - BookService (hardcoded data, Observable returns), CartService (BehaviorSubject cart state), OrderService (BehaviorSubject order state). src/app/components/ - 6 Angular standalone components (header, book-list, book-detail, cart, checkout, order-confirmation) with inline templates/styles. public/ - favicon.ico only. Root - Angular config files (angular.json, tsconfig*.json, karma.conf.js).
